solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Steps taken by court official to provide lofty data

parts.note: a flight is a run of steps or stairs
a recorder is a judge sitting in some British courts

explanation.surface: A court official climbs the stairs to deliver some high-level information.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lofty data' is a playful definition: the device logs what happens while a plane is up in the air.
explanation.definitionFit: The black box on an aircraft stores information gathered while airborne, hence data from on high.

parts.note: read as a date, day one of month one, rather than as a fraction equal to one

explanation.definitionFit: In date notation 1/1 means the opening day of the year's opening month, New Year's Day.

clue.text: Is dip in tasteless form?

indicators.note: the letters of the first three words are put into a new form

explanation.surface: A question of whether a dip served at a party is bland.
explanation.definitionFit: Insipid food lacks flavour, a direct synonym for tasteless.

clue.text: Shears and drier maketh the man

definitions.text: Shears and drier maketh the man

indicators.note: the old proverb 'manners maketh man' is twisted so that the letters make a new word

explanation.surface: A play on the proverb: scissors and a blow-dryer are what make a man presentable.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the letters of SHEARS and DRIER rearranged give a person who uses those very tools to groom a man.
explanation.definitionFit: A barber or stylist works with shears and a drier to smarten a customer, so the whole clue describes such a person.

clue.text: Beaver among the reeds trod enthusiastically

indicators.note: the answer sits among the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A beaver trampling eagerly through the reed beds.
explanation.walkthrough: The run spans the end of 'trod' and the start of 'enthusiastically'.
explanation.definitionFit: The beaver is a large gnawing mammal, an example of the order of gnawers.

clue.text: Period for talking on mobile phone used to halt drinking session

definitions.text: Period for talking on mobile phone
definitions.meaning: airtime minutes in a mobile phone contract
what a British landlord does at closing, announcing the bar is shut

explanation.surface: Phone minutes being used to end a night at the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: In a British pub the landlord rings a bell and announces last orders at closing.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means minutes of airtime on a phone, and also a publican's announcement that drinking must stop.

clue.text: Potential swimmers use oars, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the word must be spoken, not spelt

parts.note: to row is to propel a boat with oars

explanation.surface: Rowers out on the water, with a passing remark on swimming.
explanation.definitionFit: Fish eggs are a mass of future fish, swimmers yet to hatch.

clue.text: Tess and I go crazy for clever dicks!

indicators.note: going crazy means the letters lose their order

explanation.surface: Tess and her friend lose their minds over smart alecks.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-satisfied know-alls are full of themselves, close in sense to conceited self-centred people.

clue.text: It's only relative

parts.note: reads like a shrug about relativity, but means someone accepted as a relative

explanation.definitionFit: Someone treated as a kin member is, as far as the household goes, simply a relation.

clue.text: Countermand as noisily offended again

indicators.note: tells us the words are heard, so a sound-alike is needed

parts.note: to sin again is to re-sin; said out loud it matches the answer

explanation.surface: Someone shouting as they overturn an order after repeated misbehaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: To countermand an order is to revoke or cancel it, a synonym.

clue.text: One wild to become prostrate

indicators.note: the letters of the first two words are made into a new word

explanation.surface: A wild creature is told to get down flat.
explanation.definitionFit: To prostrate oneself is to stretch out flat, just as to recline at full length on the floor.

clue.text: Bonus point

definitions.meaning: a gratuity given to a waiter on top of the bill
the pointed end of something, such as a pencil

explanation.surface: Extra reward and a scoring mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A gratuity is a little extra money, and the end of something sharp is also called by the same word.

clue.text: On board, a godson opts to change instruction on the way to jail

definitions.text: instruction on the way to jail

indicators.note: the words before are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A godson playing a board game chooses to alter a rule about going to prison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On board' sets the scene: in the property-trading board game Monopoly a card sending you to jail tells you not to collect money as you pass the start square.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the board-game card's order to a player heading straight to jail without passing the start.

clue.text: Level never before reached as always stoned

parts.note: all the time means always
high is slang for intoxicated by drugs

explanation.surface: Someone permanently intoxicated reaching new heights.
explanation.definitionFit: A record peak is a figure greater than any previously recorded.

clue.text: Fret over some scattered light, eg, diffraction

indicators.note: turned over, so the selected letters are read backwards
only some of the letters of the following words are used

explanation.surface: A physicist worries about light scattering in a diffraction experiment.
explanation.walkthrough: Read backwards through 'lighT EG DIFfraction' to find the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To fret is to be restless and anxious, as one who cannot keep still.

clue.text: Not a very large orbiting item

definitions.text: Not a very large orbiting item

parts.words: Not a very large orbiting item
parts.note: describes a compact artificial satellite, a modest craft in space

explanation.definitionFit: A minisatellite in orbit, a craft built small and light, is described exactly by the clue.

clue.text: Horned elk and ox stampeded

indicators.note: running wildly in a stampede, the letters lose their order

explanation.surface: An elk and an ox charging off with their horns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Horned' looks like a description of the beasts but is a verb: sounded a car horn.
explanation.definitionFit: A klaxon is a loud electric horn, so to sound one is to have horned.

clue.text: Was Eros also affected by spray containers?

indicators.note: the letters of these two words are altered into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Asks whether the god of love was harmed by spray cans.
explanation.definitionFit: Cans that release their contents as a fine mist are pressurised spray canisters.

clue.text: Salmon displaying communist angle!

parts.note: red is a common term for a communist
to angle is to fish with rod and line

explanation.surface: A salmon showing a political bias.
explanation.definitionFit: A salmon, especially when spawning, is called a red-fleshed fish of this name.

clue.text: Six got up in poisonous fashion

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
rose means got up out of bed

explanation.surface: Six people getting up in a venomous mood.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a rare word meaning toxic or foul-smelling, from the Latin for poison.

clue.text: Alternative leafstalk found in the fruit trees

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
chard is a beet grown for its edible leaf stalks

explanation.surface: Another option for a stalk is found among the fruit trees.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchard is a plot planted with fruit-bearing trees.

clue.text: Company design is very loud, so sign out

parts.note: a logo is a company's emblem
ff is fortissimo, the musical direction for very loud

explanation.surface: A firm's emblem is too garish, so someone signs out.
explanation.definitionFit: To sign out of a computer system is to end a session there, a synonym.

clue.text: Display too little below exhibit

parts.note: under means below
to expose is to show or exhibit

explanation.surface: A curator puts too little on show beneath an exhibit.
explanation.walkthrough: In photography this means letting too little light reach the film.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a photograph or subject too little exposure is to show it insufficiently.

clue.text: Refreshment for church associate

parts.note: CH is the standard abbreviation for church; that the letters also run on into 'associate' is a coincidence, not a hidden word
A is an abbreviation for associate, as in degree titles

explanation.surface: A drink served for a parish helper.
explanation.definitionFit: Cha is a slang word for tea, a refreshing drink.

clue.text: Checks brakes at home

parts.note: reins act as brakes, checking a horse
in means at home

explanation.surface: Someone checks a car's brakes while at home.
explanation.definitionFit: To curb or restrain something is to pull it back, as a rider does with a horse.

clue.text: Take her to court

parts.note: reads as courting a woman, but means bringing legal action, and the woman's name fits too

explanation.definitionFit: To bring legal action against someone is to take them to court, and it is also a woman's name, hence 'her'.

clue.text: International wise men go West after starting oriental renaissance art

indicators.note: the reversed piece comes after the starting letters
the starting letters of the two words are taken
in an across clue going west means reading right to left

parts.note: the Magi were the wise men of the nativity

explanation.surface: Wise men travel westward after the dawn of an Eastern artistic revival.
explanation.definitionFit: Origami is the Japanese art of paper folding, an example of an art.

clue.text: Finally, an eventide event

definitions.meaning: the idiom meaning ultimately, when all is considered
literally the close of daylight, what happens at evening

explanation.surface: Ultimately, something that happens in the evening.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means ultimately, and taken literally it describes nightfall, an evening happening.
